## Load Libraries 
```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(here)
```


## Load Data 
```{r}
beacon <- read_csv(here("GoodPlotBadPlot","Data","beacon_data.csv")) |> 
          filter(ReefSiteName!="}") # Had one bad data point, so I filtered it out 
```
This data is .... 


## Bad Plot 

```{r}
BadPlot <- beacon |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=DIC, y= TA)) +
  geom_point(color= "magenta", size=16, shape = 8, alpha=1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "yellow") +
  labs(title="BEACON!!!", x="DIC", y="TA")+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size=47, color= "blue", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill="green"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill="orange"),
    axis.text = element_text(size=5),
    axis.title = element_text(size=63))

BadPlot

ggsave(here("GoodPlotBadPlot", "Outputs", "BadPlot_CarolinaMD.png"),
       width = 12,
       height = 8)
```

## Good Plot 
```{r}
GoodPlot <- beacon |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=DIC, y= TA, shape =ReefSiteName, color=ReefSiteName, group=ReefSiteName)) + #I want shapes for the reef sites
   geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.8) +
   scale_color_manual(values = c("#67001f", "#b2182b", "#d6604d", "#f4a582"))+
   scale_shape_manual(values= c(16,17,15,18))+ # these numbers are shapes for each reef site
   labs(x="Dissolved Inorganic Carbon (µmol/kg)", y="Total Alkalinity (µmol/kg)", shape = "Reef Site", color = "Reef Site")+ #Just learned that to change the legend title of a variable that has both a color & shape, you have to use color and shape 
   theme_classic()+
   theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title = element_text(size=14),
        legend.title= element_text(size=12),
        legend.text= element_text(size=11))

GoodPlot 

ggsave(here("GoodPlotBadPlot", "Outputs", "GoodPlot_CarolinaMD.png"),
       width = 12,
       height = 8)
```
